summary: CAIR Action endorsed LaCroix in the general-election phase for the San Francisco Community College District Trustee seat, at the full endorsement tier rather than a preferred or ally level. The organization develops its recommendations by weighing civil-rights and foreign-policy positions, including on Gaza and ceasefire, and treats its endorsements as concrete directional evidence for the candidate. LaCroix is a nonpartisan candidate for an at-large board position.
